scope: Discrete device classes intersected with fixed slot budgets and three-wire balanced winding constraints

parameters.winding_layer: double layer Q coils; single-layer capacity bound separately

one_cell_rejection.reason: One selected pole order cannot be suppressed independently

illustrative_terminal_model.assumption: terminal-equivalent scaling from the earlier illustrative model; not identified geometry

limits: Sufficient uniform-triple family with exact equal modal gain across cells
Rejection is not a universal impossibility theorem
3:1 not demonstrated in this family; different multi-coil layouts remain open
Pitch factors do not establish loss, torque or rotor feasibility
Device resistance screen is part-specific at 25 C, not a full thermal or switching loss calculation
No global optimal device or cell count is claimed
